function_summary: TTL smart actuator with position and continuous-rotation control plus motion feedback.
classification_reason: Suggested as an arm joint; its other operating modes also suit wheel drives or pan-tilt heads. One actuator is not an assembled limb.
assembly_notes: One servo with preinstalled horn, TTL cable, bolts and spacers; body links and controller are separate.
evidence_note: Product lists arm, wheel and pan-tilt use cases and a one-servo package; use current XL430(new) CAD revision. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

function_summary: Compact 5 V smart servo with position, velocity and current control.
classification_reason: Suggested as a small arm joint; may also actuate a light drive or sensor mount. It supplies no complete limb structure.
assembly_notes: Package lists one XL330-M288-T, one TTL cable and horn/frame bolts; controller and linkage are separate.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies compact robotic arms and mobile robots and lists position/velocity/current modes. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

function_summary: USB interface that lets a computer communicate with TTL and RS-485 DYNAMIXEL actuators.
classification_reason: Communication electronics support joints; the adapter does not itself produce movement or provide a body segment.
assembly_notes: External actuator power is required. Page announces USB-C but its package table still says Micro USB; verify supplied cable/revision.
evidence_note: Page explicitly describes a USB communication converter and states it does not power DYNAMIXEL. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

function_summary: Cortex-M7 robot control board with DYNAMIXEL interfaces and onboard inertial sensing.
classification_reason: Internal control electronics belong to support even when physically mounted in a torso.
assembly_notes: Package contains one OpenCR1.0 and one Micro-B USB cable; host SBC, actuators and operating power source are separate.
evidence_note: Overview identifies the TurtleBot3 controller and lists RS-485, TTL, UART, CAN and inertial sensors. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

classification_reason: Controls other robot parts; it is not a structural body or completed limb.
assembly_notes: One OpenRB-150 board; batteries and cables explicitly excluded.
evidence_note: Package contents name an Arduino-compatible DYNAMIXEL controller and exclude batteries and cables. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

function_summary: Measures nearby wall or object distance over a 10–80 cm range.
classification_reason: Perception component for a conceptual head; no head housing or articulation is included.
assembly_notes: One DMS-80 plus one 150 mm sensor cable; requires a compatible controller.
evidence_note: Vendor describes wall/object distance detection and lists a 10–80 cm detection range. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

function_summary: Gyroscope measures angular velocity for robot tilt estimation and balance control.
classification_reason: Proprioceptive sensing supports balance rather than serving as an outward-looking head. Taxonomy imu includes this gyro-only sensor.
assembly_notes: One GS-12 with two 160 mm cables; this is a gyroscope, not a full accelerometer/gyro/magnetometer IMU.
evidence_note: Page states angular-velocity measurement, inclination estimation and balancing applications. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

function_summary: TurtleBot3 Burger mobile ROS robot kit with Raspberry Pi 4 4 GB and LDS ranging sensor.
classification_reason: A robot kit spans a wheeled base, supporting frame and perception; do not sell or count it as a single leg.
assembly_notes: Assembly kit variant is RPi4 4GB US. Vendor notes revised LDS sensor, matching USB2LDS adapter and required cables; older USB2LDS is incompatible with that sensor revision.
evidence_note: Exact product identifies TurtleBot3 Burger RPi4 4GB; overview explicitly discusses included LDS, USB2LDS and cables. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

function_summary: Pair of rubber-tired drive wheels that bolt to compatible DYNAMIXEL actuators.
classification_reason: Ground-contact locomotion parts represent legs/wheels; motors and supporting base are separate.
assembly_notes: Sold as a set of two wheels and two tires with twenty M2x4K screws; no DYNAMIXEL actuator included.
evidence_note: Package lists two sprocket wheels, two TR-66 tires and screws; vendor explains attachment to DYNAMIXEL. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

function_summary: Passive ball caster supports a wheeled robot base while rolling freely.
classification_reason: Ground support belongs to locomotion; this passive caster cannot propel the robot.
assembly_notes: One frame-and-steel-ball caster with five screws and five rivets; intended for 6 mm plates/TB3 Waffle Plate.
evidence_note: Package lists one caster assembly; compatibility section names 6 mm plates and the TB3 Waffle Plate. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

function_summary: Rechargeable 11.1 V 1800 mAh lithium-polymer battery with protection circuitry.
classification_reason: Stores operating energy for robot systems and has no independent anatomical function.
assembly_notes: One LB-012 battery; LBC-010 charger sold separately. Vendor lists TurtleBot3/OpenCR/OP compatibility and excludes other CM-series controllers.
evidence_note: Page provides voltage/capacity, package quantity, charger exclusion and connector compatibility limitations. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.

function_summary: AC mains adapter supplying 12 V DC at up to 5 A to compatible robot electronics or a charger.
classification_reason: External power support; it is neither a battery nor a structural body part.
assembly_notes: One PS-10 supply and AC cord. Battery charging requires a separate charger between supply and battery.
evidence_note: Package includes supply and cord; wiring examples show battery charging through a separate battery charger. Official product page fetched directly over HTTPS with HTTP 200 and inspected on the research date.
